title: Jewel beetles mating with stubby beer bottles

tellings.quote: So they they some guys, you know, in Australia drink them, throw them out into outback and drive off. And the male jewel beetles flock to these bottles.

plain: In the Australian outback, men drink beer from short brown bottles called stubbies, throw them out and drive off, and male jewel beetles flock to the bottles and try to mate with them, mistaking them for females. The researcher Don Hoffman tells Michels this without naming a source. He uses it to argue that our senses evolved to show us only what helped us survive, so we might miss aliens even if they were all around us.
